Combine the study of law and business with the LLM International Commercial Law. This interdisciplinary course is taught by the School of Law and the ICMA Centre, part of the renowned Henley Business School.

This program will prepare students to graduate with a diverse portfolio and skill set through Reading's:

  • practice-focused approach. Develop valuable links with employers, gain real-world experience, and embed learning in professional practice.
  • focus on research intensity. Advance research skills with the support of experienced academics.

Students will develop a comparative, international perspective of commercial law and benefit from:

  • high quality teaching and modules led by expert academic researchers and practitioners
  • opportunities to hear from guest speakers who excel in their fields
  • a dynamic, learning environment.

Program Description

The MRes Agriculture and Food Economics at Reading will prepare you for doctoral studies in agricultural and food economics and marketing. It provides rigorous training in research methods to prepare students for research careers in academia or in non-academic organizations.

This master's program will:

  • prepare students for doctoral studies in agricultural and food economics and marketing.
  • equip them with applied economics, marketing and quantitative and qualitative research techniques.
  • give them the opportunity to apply their learning to a diverse range of contemporary farm, food and rural issues in both developed and developing country contexts.

During the studies, students will develop applied economics and marketing skills – including quantitative and qualitative research techniques – and then apply them to a diverse range of contemporary farm, food and rural issues in both developed and developing country contexts.

Program Description

The MSc Business Economics is a degree designed to expose students to the most up-to-date analyses of business economics, at both firm and industry level, from internationally renowned experts. Specialize by choosing from a range of optional modules, such as International Business, Economics of Development, The Economics of Financial Markets and Economics of Public Policy.

Students will be joining a department that is notable for the range of internationally recognized research that it conducts, including in business economics.

In studying MSc Business Economics students will utilize techniques and evidence in order to understand how industries are structured, how organizations behave within them and the impact of these factors on their performance.
